item.title: 14k-Mile 1976 Chevrolet Cosworth Vega Hatchback Coupe 5-Speed
item.description: This 1976 Chevrolet Vega hatchback coupe is one of approximately 3,500 examples produced during the two-year production run, and it now shows 14k miles after reportedly spending time with two owners. Power is provided by a 2.0-liter twin-cam inline-four with electronic fuel injection linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a Positraction limited-slip differential. item.title: Neon Gulf Ford GT40-Style Sign at No Reserve
item.description: This neon sign is constructed in the shape of a Ford GT40 and displays a Gulf #6 livery accented by multi-color neon tubing. The piece measures approximately 60″ long by 16″ tall by 6.5″ deep. It has a black metal enclosure with pre-drilled mounting holes on the back, is wired for 120-volt circuitry, and has two power cords with US-style wall plugs. This Gulf GT40-style neon sign was acquired by the seller in 2025 and is now offered at no reserve in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

item.description: This 1999 BMW M3 convertible is finished in Cosmos Black Metallic over Light Gray Nappa leather and has 93k miles. It is powered by a 3.2-liter inline-six paired with a five-speed automatic transmission and is further equipped with a limited-slip differential, a convertible soft top, fog lights, 17" Style 24 wheels, cruise control, an Alpine stereo, and dual-zone climate control.
